source_of_truth: Chapters 12, 13, 14 and 15 of KneeSchool_Master_Operations_Handbook.pdf, under the authority order confirmed by decision 009.
base_url_note: Confirmed by the client on 9 October 2026 as the live domain, and named as KneeSchool.com in chapter 1 of the Master Operations Handbook. Every canonical link is built from this value, so if the domain ever changes this is the one line to change.

seo.note: Chapter 14 requires an SEO title, a meta description, a slug, an H1, an H2 structure, related articles, internal links and image alt text on every page. The bounds are the ordinary search engine display limits; the handbook does not state numbers.

medical_safety.required_sentence: It does not give individual medical advice and it does not replace assessment by a clinician
medical_safety.source: Chapter 12, Medical Safety: patient-facing pages must explain that information is educational and not a substitute for professional assessment.
medical_safety.applies_to: every page, not only the patient facing ones, because a reader arrives at a professional page as easily as a patient one

theme_color_note: The browser tab and mobile address bar colour. It is --green-deep from the design system, repeated here because an HTML meta tag cannot read a CSS custom property. It is the only colour literal the site check allows outside the stylesheet's :root block.
discoverable_note: Whether search engines may index the site. The client's position on 10 October 2026 is that the site can be published but will not be publicised until it is verified. A live site that search engines index is publicised, so while this is false every page carries a robots noindex directive and robots.txt disallows every crawler. Set it true when verification is done and run tools/apply_chrome.py: that is the whole of the change. Indexing is not fully reversible, because a page can stay cached after it is removed, which is why the default here is the cautious one. See decision 015.
